stance_basis: cited solely as a technical data source for seismic intensity estimates, with no position on the project
summary: NOAA is cited twice in the seismic section of the EIS as the source of Modified Mercalli Intensity estimates for earthquake scenarios affecting the starter line area. The agency provides technical data on ground shaking intensities for both a Magnitude 7.5 Newport-Inglewood Fault event and a Magnitude 8.3 San Andreas Fault event, but expresses no opinion on the project itself.
complaint_summary: NOAA (1973) is cited as the source for Modified Mercalli Intensity estimates of VII to IX for a Magnitude 7.5 Newport-Inglewood Fault earthquake and V to VIII for a Magnitude 8.3 San Andreas Fault earthquake affecting the starter line area.
summary_quote: The most severe ground shaking that would be felt in the starter line area would be generated by a Magnitude 7.5 earthquake occurring on the Newport-Inglewood Fault, giving Modified Mercalli Intensities of VII to IX (NOAA, 1973).
